g.title: W3
g.text: AGND joins GND at one point on the EPS (star). Enables: outputs low at reset, pull-downs on the EPS (RF_TX_EN mandatory). Burn lines gate the drivers of schematic S5

g.title: J_OBC
g.text: OBC board: PF1, PF0, PB7, PB4, PB5, PB6, PD2, PA1, PA3, PE4, PE2, PB9, PB10, PB11, PB12, PC2, PC3, PC4, PC5, PB0
